faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur RA post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Research Associate (RA) - Research position at IIT Kharagpur is 23 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to apply well before the deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate (RA) - Research position under the current recruitment notification released by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur for their project-based requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the RA post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate (RA) - Research position is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per the rules of the sponsoring agency mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates applying for the Research Associate (RA) - Research position. The application process is completely free of cost for all categories of applicants.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the RA post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree. Alternatively, those with an MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech degree with 3 years of research/teaching experience and at least one SCI journal publication are also eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q6. How will the selection process be conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing candidates based on the information provided during the online application process, followed by a mandatory document and testimonial verification stage to confirm the eligibility of the candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is for a project-based position. The Research Associate (RA) - Research post is associated with a specific research project and is not a permanent government job position at the institute.

faq.question: Q8. Can I submit a hard copy of my application?
faq.answer: No, the institute does not accept hard copies of the application. All candidates are required to submit their applications exclusively through the online portal provided by the IIT Kharagpur SRIC department.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Associate (RA) - Research position is New Delhi, pincode 110011. Candidates should be prepared to work in the specified location as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification for the IIT Kharagpur Research Associate (RA) - Research recruitment can be accessed via the official website of the institute or through the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
